definition.zh: 按知识如何进入研发、验证和市场组织案例。模式是基于官方案例的分析类型，不是国家的唯一特征；要素流动、生态适配和治理缺口保留为问题维度。
definition.en: Cases are organised by how knowledge enters research, validation and markets. Models are evidence-informed analytical types, not exclusive national traits. Mobility, adaptation and governance remain problem dimensions.

name.zh: 美国硅谷：科研创业网络

mechanism.zh: 专业许可与早期转化支持衔接发明，创业者社群提供导师、人才及同行服务；投资决策与大学科研评价分开。
mechanism.en: Professional licensing and early transfer support connect inventions to use, while founder networks supply mentoring and talent; investment and academic evaluation remain distinct.

conditions.zh: 有可转移的研究成果、专业技术经理人和创业者；知识产权归属、利益冲突规则及风险资本退出渠道可执行。
conditions.en: Transferable research, professional licensing staff and founders; enforceable IP and conflict rules and viable investor exit routes.

factors.zh: 大学知识、创业人才、导师网络和耐心资本相互补充，单建孵化空间不足以复制。
factors.en: Research, founders, mentoring and patient capital complement each other; incubator space alone cannot reproduce the model.

government.zh: 支持概念验证和技术经理人服务，健全权益与利益冲突规则；不以政府基金替代企业和投资人的商业判断。
government.en: Support proof of concept and professional transfer services, clarify rights and conflicts, and avoid replacing commercial selection with public funds.

boundary.zh: 两个节点用于解释机制，不是对硅谷全部企业的普查，也不证明该模式适用于所有行业。
boundary.en: Two nodes illustrate mechanisms, not a Silicon Valley census or universal sectoral applicability.

name.zh: 美国：任务牵引的高风险研发

mechanism.zh: 公共资助围绕能源技术问题配置研发项目；成果能否进入市场仍需工程验证、企业承接及后续融资。
mechanism.en: Public funding organises projects around energy-technology problems; engineering validation, firm adoption and follow-on finance remain necessary.

conditions.zh: 具备技术评审与项目管理能力，允许高风险项目失败，并能区分技术目标与已实现成果。
conditions.en: Technical assessment and project-management capability, tolerance for failure, and separation of objectives from realised outcomes.

factors.zh: 定向公共资本与科研能力组织技术探索；项目资助额不等于实际支出或商业回报。
factors.en: Directed public capital and research capabilities support exploration; awards are not expenditure or commercial returns.

government.zh: 围绕可验证的技术瓶颈设置阶段节点，基础探索、示范与推广分别考核，保留终止和调整机制。
government.en: Set milestones around verifiable bottlenecks, evaluate exploration and demonstration separately, and retain termination/adaptation mechanisms.

boundary.zh: 只描述所收录的ARPA-E项目渠道，不代表美国整体创新结构，也不与欧盟资助金额合并排名。
boundary.en: Describes the sampled ARPA-E channel, not all US innovation; USD and EU grant amounts are not combined for rankings.

mechanism.zh: 应用研究机构通过企业合同与竞争性公共项目连接科研和工业；长期研发能力支撑反复服务企业。
mechanism.en: Applied-research institutes connect science and industry through industrial contracts and competitive public projects, supported by sustained research capability.

conditions.zh: 企业有真实付费研发需求，研究单元能交付工程技术，合同能明确成本、知识产权和验收。
conditions.en: Firms with paid R&D demand, technically capable research units, and contracts defining costs, IP and acceptance.

factors.zh: 稳定的前竞争研究与市场化技术服务互补；制造业客户基础影响可持续运营。
factors.en: Stable pre-competitive research complements market-facing services; manufacturing customers underpin operating sustainability.

government.zh: 支持长期共性能力，企业专有研发按合同结算；分类评价公共研究和产业服务，不机械照搬固定经费比例。
government.en: Fund long-term shared capabilities, contract proprietary R&D, and assess public research separately from industrial services without copying fixed funding ratios.

boundary.zh: 弗劳恩霍夫是一个代表性组织，不是德国所有企业的模式；合同需求弱的地区不能照搬其经营条件。
boundary.en: Fraunhofer is an illustrative organisation, not all German industry; weak contract demand limits transferability.

name.zh: 日本：公共研究桥接与联合示范

mechanism.zh: 公共研究能力由专业转化机构连接到企业工程和商业需求；NEDO示范另通过政府与企业协同检验系统应用。
mechanism.en: Specialised transfer organisations connect public research to firms' engineering and business needs; NEDO demonstrations separately test systems with public and industrial partners.

conditions.zh: 有可承接研发成果的企业、专业工程团队及可运行的试验场景，示范伙伴责任清楚。
conditions.en: Capable adopting firms, engineering teams and operational test settings with clear partner responsibilities.

factors.zh: 既有工业技术积累与公共研究互补；跨国示范还需适配能源系统、城市管理和用户条件。
factors.en: Industrial know-how complements public research; overseas demonstrations also need energy-system, urban and user adaptation.

government.zh: 支持研究与转化职能专业分工，联合示范事先明确运营、数据使用和退出责任。
government.en: Specialise research and transfer functions and define operations, data use and exit responsibilities before joint demonstrations.

boundary.zh: 研究桥接与城市示范是两种互补工具，不将其合并为日本唯一的产业模式。
boundary.en: Research bridging and urban demonstration are complementary tools, not one exclusive Japanese model.

mechanism.zh: 以项目任务将科研、设备、制造与应用方分工连接，利用多国设施和专业能力共同验证技术。
mechanism.en: Project tasks connect science, equipment, manufacturing and application partners, using facilities and capabilities across countries.

conditions.zh: 资助规则、合作协议与知识产权安排可衔接，有能力管理多方交付及跨场景验证。
conditions.en: Compatible funding, collaboration and IP arrangements and capacity to manage multi-party delivery and cross-setting validation.

factors.zh: 技术互补和试验场景比单纯增加合作国更重要；企业与科研主体都需有明确任务。
factors.en: Complementary technologies and test settings matter more than adding flags; both firms and researchers need defined tasks.

government.zh: 为跨区域共性任务提供联合申报和设施开放规则，协调资助周期，不以参与机构数作为主要成效。
government.en: Provide joint calls and open-facility rules, align funding cycles, and avoid using participant counts as the main outcome.

boundary.zh: 统计限于经筛选的能源合作项目；欧盟项目协调国不是全部设施和受益地，登记目标不是完成成果。
boundary.en: Statistics concern selected energy collaborations; coordinator countries are not all facility/beneficiary locations and registered objectives are not outcomes.

name.zh: 新加坡：产业会员与共享验证
name.en: Singapore: industrial membership and shared validation

mechanism.zh: 研究机构与产业会员持续输入技术需求，利用共享研发和验证设施降低企业独立建设成本。
mechanism.en: Research organisations and industrial members supply recurring demand and share R&D/validation facilities.

conditions.zh: 产业会员有持续需求，服务范围、费用、知识产权和设施排期清晰，可形成长期运营。
conditions.en: Recurring member demand and clear service scope, charges, IP and facility scheduling enable sustainable operations.

factors.zh: 专业设施、工程人才与产业需求汇聚；平台开放程度须与专有技术保护协调。
factors.en: Specialist facilities and engineers meet industrial demand, with openness balanced against proprietary technology.

government.zh: 支持公共测试和产业会员共同治理，以企业复用、交付周期和有效验证评价平台。
government.en: Support shared testing and member governance, evaluating repeat use, delivery time and valid tests.

boundary.zh: 小型开放经济体的产业集中度与中国各地不同，不能按人口或财政规模直接复制。
boundary.en: A small open economy differs from Chinese regions in industrial concentration; population or budget scale is not a replication rule.

name.zh: 巴西与非洲案例：需求牵引的能力建设
name.en: Brazil and African cases: demand-led capability building

mechanism.zh: 巴西以研究单元承接企业研发；肯尼亚和摩洛哥的案例将早期技术服务、验证与融资准备衔接。
mechanism.en: Brazilian research units deliver firm R&D; Kenyan and Moroccan examples connect early technical services, validation and investment readiness.

conditions.zh: 先确定企业能力和本地需求，技术、市场与融资障碍分开处理，不要求一次建成完整创新链。
conditions.en: Identify firm capabilities and local demand first; treat technical, market and finance constraints separately.

factors.zh: 吸收能力、试验环境和早期企业服务的缺口不同，不能把发展中经济体看作同质群体。
factors.en: Absorptive capacity, test environments and early-firm service gaps differ; developing economies are not homogeneous.

government.zh: 按企业阶段提供小额验证、专业辅导和联合资助，优先解决实际采用障碍。
government.en: Provide stage-matched validation, specialist guidance and co-funding focused on adoption barriers.

boundary.zh: 三个案例是差异对照，不代表拉美或非洲总体，亦不构成统一的‘发展中国家模式’。
boundary.en: Three cases illustrate differences, not Latin America/Africa as a whole or a single developing-country model.

name.zh: 广东：制造需求与研发孵化衔接
name.en: Guangdong: manufacturing demand linked to R&D and incubation

mechanism.zh: 佛山、东莞案例从装备与工艺需求组织校企团队；松山湖连接材料中试与孵化，深圳案例体现专业研究桥接。
mechanism.en: Foshan/Dongguan cases organise teams around equipment and process needs; Songshan Lake links materials pilots with incubation, while Shenzhen cases provide specialised research bridging.

conditions.zh: 有愿意共同开发的制造企业和工程人才，工艺验证、供应链及创业服务能够连续衔接。
conditions.en: Manufacturers willing to co-develop, engineering talent, and continuity across process validation, supply chains and venture services.

factors.zh: 近距离的制造需求有利于反复试验；其作用是待检验的解释，不是由八个案例证明的省际因果关系。
factors.en: Nearby manufacturing demand may support repeated trials; this is an explanatory hypothesis, not a provincial causal effect proven by eight cases.

government.zh: 补足可靠性测试、中试和技术经理人等共性环节，企业负责专有研发与验收，避免以园区面积和孵化数量代替质量。
government.en: Fill shared gaps in reliability testing, piloting and transfer services; firms own proprietary R&D and acceptance, without substituting park area or startup counts for quality.

boundary.zh: 样本集中在珠三角，不能覆盖广东所有城市，也不能说明广东仅采用制造集群模式。
boundary.en: Cases concentrate on the Pearl River Delta, not all Guangdong cities; other models coexist.

name.zh: 浙江：校地网络与专业化验证
name.en: Zhejiang: university–local networks and specialised validation

mechanism.zh: 绍兴以校地研究院接入化工、电池和厨电需求，宁波与舟山案例把概念验证、中试和产业资本衔接。
mechanism.en: Shaoxing institutes link universities to chemicals, batteries and appliances; Ningbo/Zhoushan cases connect proof of concept, piloting and industrial capital.

conditions.zh: 地方产业问题清晰，外部高校与本地企业长期合作，化工等专业中试满足安全及工程条件。
conditions.en: Clear local industrial problems, durable university–firm collaboration, and safe engineering conditions for specialised pilots.

factors.zh: 引入外部学科能力与分散产业需求形成匹配；之江、北航案例同时表明任务导向研究也在当地存在。
factors.en: External disciplinary capabilities match distributed industrial demand; Zhejiang Lab and Beihang also demonstrate local mission-oriented research.

government.zh: 将企业出题、研究院研发和专业验证串联，跨市共享高成本设施，区分独立运营平台与同一机构下属中心。
government.en: Connect firm-defined tasks, institute R&D and specialist validation; share costly facilities across cities and distinguish operators from subordinate centres.

boundary.zh: 案例以杭州、绍兴、宁波和舟山为主，不能用样本数量说明全省实力，更不能据此断言浙江优于广东。
boundary.en: Cases concentrate on Hangzhou, Shaoxing, Ningbo and Zhoushan; sample size is not provincial strength or superiority over Guangdong.
